Public saunas in Denver, CO

Denver mixes an old-school Russian banya that has been running since 1927 with a wave of newer community sauna and cold-plunge spots, several of them outdoors next to breweries and yoga studios.

5 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-10-21. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.
